prompts.idle: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: authored 2D game sprite animation sheet. Reference identity is cute menacing charcoal BLACK TRASH BAG, tied neck/top with folded fan-like bag flaps, shiny warm gold and blue edge highlights, existing torn zigzag seams revealing orange/green food scraps and green slime, exactly TWO amber-yellow glowing eyes contained inside dark socket outlines and one zigzag mouth with little red tongue. No arms/legs/feet. Remove ALL surrounding flies and yellow fly motion marks from reference; game spawns flies as separate actors. Same painterly polished outlined style and three-quarter facing screen-right. EXACTLY FOUR complete bag drawings in strict equal TWO rows TWO columns, same camera/scale, each entirely inside cell with at most60%width/height, full tied top visible, generous empty transparent central gutters and margins. Real transparent alpha, no scenery/ground shadows/haze/text/grid/arrows/external particles/flies/extra objects. Genuine changes to plastic folds, neck and weighted body shape, not a static sprite zoomed or translated four times. Four idle poses:1 neutral sack planted, eyes open;2 subtle knot flap settling and fold tension adjustment, eyes open;3 BOTH eyelids half cover the yellow eye sockets, glows remain inside;4 BOTH eyes FULLY SHUT as black curved closed seams, NO visible yellow eye glow or iris. Keep sack base planted, same overall mass.
